sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: dealer); size 316 x 377 x 103 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Avid S1 Guide v2025.6, appendix B and the connections pages, opened 2026-11-12 (read as text): front height 1.1 in (29 mm), rear height 4.1 in (103 mm), width 12.4 in (316 mm), depth 14.9 in (377 mm), 1.89 kg, 8 motorised touch-sensitive 100 mm faders; rear: a power switch, a DC In jack for the external adapter, a 1000BASE-T RJ45 Ethernet port (EUCON link to the workstation), a USB port that only powers a tablet, a 1/4 in footswitch input. Only the Ethernet port has a catalogue signal (ethernet-control); the DC jack, the USB charging port and the footswitch are not modelled, so there is no mains inlet and no power control. The profile is flat for 40 mm at the documented rear height, then the straight line to the documented front height (the guide gives no intermediate height); older dealer listings give 312 mm wide and 97 mm at the rear. Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, faders, knobs and screens drawn without lettering, no photo, no logo. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess) and the side profile is an estimate drawn from the three outer sizes (no drawing opened). Connector genders not stated by the source follow the convention input = female, output = male.
Dealer size 316 x 377 mm, 29 mm front to 103 mm rear, 1.9 kg (the plan source).

Mains (review fix, read 2026-11-12 by a research pass): the Avid S1 guide says the AC cord plugs into an external power adapter whose DC cable goes to the DC In jack. No mains inlet is modelled for this device and the entry says so.
